title: Turning rendered SVG back into Mermaid source - the recovery precedence
focus: Use the five-strategy recovery precedence (script tag, data attributes, pre text, hidden templates, SVG accessibility nodes) as the spine to explain how get-md reverses client-side mermaid.js rendering on GitHub, MkDocs, and Docusaurus pages, and why the strict guard against 'Created with Mermaid' aria-labels matters.
